headline: How much longer does God mean me to be alone?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The cards were hidden, but your hand found the one whose table remains open.
The whole set of tools is still laid out for use.
You asked how much longer God means you to be alone. The open table is where my attention goes.
You are alone, and the waiting now feels both prolonged and assigned.
Something stands between your open life and companionship. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's sitting there…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You reached without seeing him and chose the card with life inside the pause.
Green leaves remain on the living wood above him.
You asked about God's meaning and the length of the pause. This card brings me to the living leaves.
Still, the companionship is absent, and the pause has become a question about God's intention.
The thing that has hold of the relationship question keeps it quiet. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what's holding the question…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing revealed the picture, yet you chose the card in full light.
The full sun is high behind the Fool.
You asked how long this solitude is meant to last. The beginning on the card catches me.
But no one is on the road with you, and you are asking whether God fixed its length.
Something appears just where the road would become shared. I don't think it started with you.
Now let's look at what's behind this…
